## VantaVault v0.5.33

Watch full VALORANT rounds, turn a replay moment into a play, and connect to the account signed into Riot Client.

### Highlights

- **Full-round replays** (replay) — Download a match replay in VALORANT, then open Round Review in VantaVault. Scrub through player movement, jump to kills and spike events, or skip the buy phase.
- **Tactics Board** — Select **Plan from here** to bring the positions and active utility from the replay into an editable play. Move agents, draw routes, and save it to your playbook.
- **Utility on the map** — Jump to recorded smokes, mollies, slows, flashes, and traps. Supported smokes show their own coverage. Chamber’s Rendezvous shows the landing spot and draws the path when the recording captures the starting point.

### Improved

- Replay Theater shows what each player is holding and lets you toggle vision cones, names, and map callouts.
- Local Client mode follows the Riot account signed in on your PC and reconnects when Riot refreshes the session.

### Fixed

- Round Review keeps the map in place while loading. Playback controls and player positions appear when the selected round is ready.
- Connection settings show **Connected** once the selected account matches the live Riot Client session.

### Download

- **Windows Portable** — `VantaVault-portable.exe`
- **Windows Installer** — `VantaVault_0.5.33_x64-setup.exe`

### Auto-update

Both Windows versions update from inside VantaVault.
